content_of_post_to_comment: We had our first ‘open house’ event at our son’s kindergarten last night. His teacher told us about the way they celebrate birthdays (sing a song, the class makes a little birthday collage). It sounds precious and lovely. Then she said that they no longer will allow kids to bring goodie bags for all the other kids on their birthday. Which, that’s good. Because I was never going to do that in a million years! Very happy to be at a school where they’re intentionally ratcheting down intensive parenting competitiveness.
comment: Interesting tension: removing goodie bags reduces comparison, but schools still need to think about how kids experience generosity without turning kindness into a performance.
